title: Asus redesigns the Zenbook Duo with a new "hideaway" hinge that shrinks the gap between the laptop's two 3K 144Hz Lumina Pro OLED displays to just 8.28 mm (Sam Rutherford/Engadget)
summary: Sam Rutherford / Engadget: Asus redesigns the Zenbook Duo with a new “hideaway” hinge that shrinks the gap between the laptop's two 3K 144Hz Lumina Pro OLED displays to just 8.28 mm — This is the revamp that I've been waiting for. — The ASUS Zenbook Duo was easily one of my favorite laptops of 2024 …
contentText:
Sam Rutherford / Engadget :

Asus redesigns the Zenbook Duo with a new “hideaway” hinge that shrinks the gap between the laptop's two 3K 144Hz Lumina Pro OLED displays to just 8.28 mm   —  This is the revamp that I've been waiting for.  —  The ASUS Zenbook Duo was easily one of my favorite laptops of 2024 …
